name: Default
shortDescription: Open source screen recording and video sharing platform, with MySQL, S3-compatible storage and an FFmpeg media server.

alerts.message: Email is not configured by default, so sign-in codes are printed in the cap service logs. Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM_DOMAIN to send them by email.
Anyone who can reach the URL can create an account. Set CAP_ALLOWED_SIGNUP_DOMAINS to a comma-separated list of your email domains to restrict sign-ups.
